trap.label: do × make
trap.wrong: I’m sorry. I did a mistake.
trap.right: I’m sorry. I made a mistake.
trap.why: Em português “cometer/fazer um erro”; o brasileiro usa do. Em inglês o erro se faz com make: make a mistake.

mcq.q: Where is your homework? ‒ I ___ forget it.

fix.wrong: I forgot my book. Sorry by that.
fix.right: I forgot my book. Sorry about that.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “I forget my homework.”
Reescreva no passado: “I make a mistake.”
